title: Islamic Inheritance Planning
description: Study of Islamic inheritance laws (Faraid) including Quranic inheritance shares and practical application.
short_description: Learn the principles of Faraid and how to plan your estate according to Islamic law

modules.title: Foundations of Islamic Inheritance
modules.description: Understanding the framework and key concepts of Faraid (Islamic inheritance law).

lessons.title: Islamic Law of Inheritance Framework
lessons.content: An overview of the Islamic law of inheritance framework, introducing Qur'anic heirs, residuary heirs (ta'sib), and distant kindred, with the forced-heirship structure of Islamic inheritance.

lessons.title: Why Sons Sometimes Receive Larger Shares
lessons.content: Understanding the Quranic basis for why male heirs may receive larger shares, exploring the Islamic principles of financial responsibility and inheritance distribution.

lessons.title: Only Daughters Surviving
lessons.content: How Islamic inheritance rules apply when only daughters survive the deceased, including the specific shares and distribution rules for this scenario.

modules.title: Advanced Inheritance Concepts
modules.description: Complex inheritance scenarios including Awl, Ta'sib, and Radd.

lessons.title: 'Awl Explained
lessons.content: Understanding the concept of 'Awl (proportionate increase) in Islamic inheritance, which occurs when the total shares of heirs exceed the available estate, requiring proportional reduction.

lessons.title: Ta'sib Explained
lessons.content: Understanding Ta'sib (agnatic residuary) in Islamic inheritance law, where certain male heirs receive the remainder of the estate after fixed-share heirs have been allocated their portions.

lessons.title: Radd vs Ta'sib
lessons.content: The distinction between Radd (return of surplus to proportionate-share heirs) and Ta'sib (agnatic residuary), and when each applies in Islamic inheritance distribution.
